Mayawati Expels Father-in-Law of Nephew Akash Anand from BSP

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has expelled senior leader Ashok Siddharth, who is the father-in-law of her nephew Akash Anand, from the party. Siddharth had previously been removed from responsibilities in Delhi, Karnataka, Odisha, and West Bengal. The expulsion comes as part of a larger organizational reshuffle within the BSP, with other leaders like Randhir Singh Beniwal also being expelled for indiscipline. Mayawati stated that Akash Anand has no role in deciding BSP candidates.
